items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Now Sam Cagliar can do the same thing with a guitar. I'm telling you, take off man, set a tempo for you that you're just as relaxed. You ought to hear that guy play, Dick.

ctx.x: What did he play in the ensemble?

Well he played chords after he took off. Yeah, after that. He didn't continue playing the lead like some guys did. No, no, no. Just a take off man. They call him a lead or take off man. Now Sam Cagliar can do the same thing with a guitar. I'm telling you, take off man, set a tempo for you that you're just as relaxed. You ought to hear that guy play, Dick.
I haven't heard him in a long time. I didn't know I used to hear him. That is nice. What was it, Magazine in Peniston? Yeah, he used to play up there, that's right.
